name: 07-management-server
title: The CloudStack management server
description: Take mgmt-01 from cloud-init Ubuntu to the estate's management plane: MySQL with the ebook's nested-lab tuning, root DB credential set from the host-side secrets file, the CloudStack 4.22 apt repo, cloudstack-management installed, databases deployed, the service answering on :8080, and the systemvm template handled per the parameterised seed mode (auto by default, explicit for offline profiles).
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-mgmt-01.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Secrets file present
steps.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && test -n "$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" && test -n "$MC_DB_PASS"' && test "$(sudo stat -c %a /root/.mc-secrets.env)" = 600 && echo SECRETS-PRESENT-OK
steps.advice:
This phase needs /root/.mc-secrets.env on this host, mode 600, owned by root.
It is not in the repository and never will be: it holds passwords, and neither
a package nor a run record is a place for those.

Create it yourself on the target host, with values of your own choosing:

    sudo install -m 600 /dev/null /root/.mc-secrets.env
    sudo tee /root/.mc-secrets.env >/dev/null <<'ENV'
    MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS='<a password you choose>'
    MC_DB_PASS='<a different password you choose>'
    ENV

This phase needs: MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS MC_DB_PASS - each one non-empty.

Beware quoting. A value containing an apostrophe will terminate its own
single-quoted string and silently swallow the following line, leaving
every variable empty while the file still looks fine. Alphanumeric
values avoid the problem entirely.

Then run this phase again. Nothing has been changed on this host.

steps.title: Apt baseline
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q chrony gnupg wget nfs-common && sudo systemctl enable --now chrony
steps.already: systemctl is-active chrony >/dev/null 2>&1 && dpkg -s nfs-common 2>/dev/null | grep -q ok.installed

steps.title: Mysql server
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q mysql-server

steps.title: Mysql lab tuning
steps.run:
sudo tee /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/cloudstack.cnf > /dev/null << 'EOF'
[mysqld]
server-id = 1
innodb_rollback_on_timeout = 1
innodb_lock_wait_timeout = 600
max_connections = {{mysql_max_connections}}
log-bin = mysql-bin
binlog-format = 'ROW'
EOF
sudo systemctl restart mysql

steps.title: Mysql root password
steps.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -e "ALTER USER '\''root'\''@'\''localhost'\'' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY '\''$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS'\'';"'

steps.title: Cloudstack apt repo
steps.run: sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings && wget -qO- https://download.cloudstack.org/release.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/cloudstack.gpg && echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/cloudstack.gpg] https://download.cloudstack.org/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) 4.22" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/cloudstack.list && sudo apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update -q

steps.title: Cloudstack management package
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q cloudstack-management

steps.title: Cloudstack databases
steps.destroys: the existing CloudStack database on this host, including every zone, host, account and volume record. There is no undo and Nano takes no backup.

steps.title: Systemvm template
steps.run:
if [ "{{seed_mode}}" = "explicit" ]; then
  sudo mkdir -p /mnt/secondary
  sudo mount -t nfs {{nfs_ip}}:/export/secondary /mnt/secondary
  sudo /usr/share/cloudstack-common/scripts/storage/secondary/cloud-install-sys-tmplt \
    -m /mnt/secondary \
    -u https://download.cloudstack.org/systemvm/4.22/systemvmtemplate-4.22.0-x86_64-kvm.qcow2.bz2 \
    -h kvm -F
  sudo umount /mnt/secondary
else
  echo 'seed_mode=auto (d-mc-020 default): management server auto-seeds the systemvm template - no manual action'
fi

checks.title: Mysql max connections applied
checks.run: sudo bash -c '. /root/.mc-secrets.env && mysql -uroot -p"$MC_MYSQL_ROOT_PASS" -N -e "show variables like \"max_connections\""' 2>/dev/null | grep -qw {{mysql_max_connections}} && echo MAXCONN-OK
